question: Which applications may be screened out at VinUni pre-screening?
expected_answer: Applications that fail eligibility criteria, including grade level, significantly low GPA or academic records, or incomplete or carelessly written applications.
expected_context: We will only screen out those applications that don’t meet the eligibility criteria, such as grade level, significantly low GPA or academic records, incomplete or carelessly written applications.

question: How is VinUni Round 2 individual assessment conducted?
expected_answer: Shortlisted applicants are interviewed remotely using interactive tools, including a personal interview or scenario-based challenge.
expected_context: VinUni will invite shortlisted applicants to attend interviews for further assessment. The assessment will be done remotely using interactive tools. This will include a personal interview/scenario-based challenge with faculty and some other activities that help you to get to know us and us to know you better.

question: Must admitted applicants submit a separate merit-based scholarship application?
expected_answer: No. All admitted candidates are automatically considered for merit-based scholarships.
expected_context: Candidates do not need to apply for merit-based scholarships. All admitted candidates will automatically be considered for merit-based scholarships.

question: When are transfer applicants considered for credit transfer?
expected_answer: Only after they have been admitted to VinUniversity.
expected_context: Applicants will be considered for credit transfer only after being admitted to VinUniversity. The relevant academic department and program office will then conduct the credit evaluation process. Applicants will be required to provide detailed course syllabi and content from their previous institution. Credits will be transferred and recognized if the course content aligns with the curricula offered at VinUniversity.

question: What minimum Vietnamese level is stated for MD transfer applicants?
expected_context: The minimum required proficiency in Vietnamese for MD program applicants is level A2.

question: Which high-school science subjects are required for MD eligibility?
expected_answer: Biology, Chemistry, and one additional science course: Math or Physics.
expected_context: Students must complete Biology, Chemistry, and one additional science course (Math or Physics) in high school in order to be eligible for the MD program.

question: What listed annual tuition does the VinUni FAQ give for Nursing?
How often is tuition paid according to the VinUni FAQ?
expected_answer: Twice a year, at the beginning of the Fall and Spring semesters.
expected_context: Tuition fee payment will be made twice a year at the beginning of each main semester (Fall Semester and Spring Semester).
